```{r cv-date, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
# Date shown in the footer. Computed in R with an explicit time zone so the
# CV is dated in Pacific time no matter where it's built (GitHub's build
# machines run on UTC, which is a day ahead in the evening).
cv_date <- format(Sys.time(), "%B %d, %Y", tz = "America/Los_Angeles")
cv_date <- sub(" 0", " ", cv_date)  # "November 02" -> "November 2"
cat("```{=latex}\n\\renewcommand{\\today}{", cv_date, "}\n```\n", sep = "")
```

```{r sections, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
# Teaching-award variant of cv.Rmd: same sections from cv_contents/, with the entries listed
# in highlights/teaching_award.txt shaded. Edit that list to change what is highlighted.
sections <- c("education", "research_interest", "Academic_positions", "honors", "writing",
              "presentation", "Funding", "Service", "Professional_memberships",
              "Teaching_experience", "Mentorship", "Additional_training")
pats <- trimws(readLines("highlights/teaching_award.txt", encoding = "UTF-8"))
pats <- pats[pats != "" & !startsWith(pats, "#")]
used <- setNames(rep(FALSE, length(pats)), pats)
out <- character()
for (f in sections) {
  lines <- readLines(file.path("cv_contents", paste0(f, ".tex")), encoding = "UTF-8")
  for (i in seq_along(lines)) {
    l <- lines[i]
    if (!grepl("^\\\\(cvrow|cvrowtight|cveduc|item)", l)) next
    hit <- vapply(pats, function(p) grepl(p, l, fixed = TRUE), logical(1))
    if (!any(hit)) next
    used[hit] <- TRUE
    lines[i] <- if (startsWith(l, "\\item "))
      paste0("\\item \\cvhlitem{", substring(l, 7), "}") else paste0("{\\cvhltrue ", l, "}")
  }
  out <- c(out, lines, "")
}
if (!all(used)) warning("Highlight entries that match nothing in the CV: ",
                        paste(names(used)[!used], collapse = " | "))
cat("```{=latex}\n", paste(out, collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```
